text: Choose the word closest in meaning to: abundant.
explanation: Abundant means present in large quantity, as plentiful does.

text: Choose the word closest in meaning to: diligent.
explanation: A diligent person works carefully and steadily, so hardworking fits.

text: Choose the word closest in meaning to: conceal.
explanation: To conceal something is to hide it from view.

text: Choose the word closest in meaning to: feeble.
explanation: Feeble means lacking strength, which is the meaning of weak.

text: Choose the word closest in meaning to: genuine.
explanation: Genuine means not copied or false, so real is the closest word.

text: Choose the word closest in meaning to: commence.
explanation: To commence is to begin or start something.

text: Choose the word closest in meaning to: reluctant.
explanation: Reluctant means not willing to do something, as unwilling does.

text: Choose the word closest in meaning to: vital.
explanation: Vital means absolutely necessary, which is what essential means.

text: Choose the word closest in meaning to: brief.
explanation: Brief means lasting a short time, so short is the closest word.

text: Choose the word closest in meaning to: ancient.
explanation: Ancient means belonging to a very distant past, so old is closest.

text: Choose the word opposite in meaning to: victory.
explanation: Victory means winning. Its opposite is defeat, which means losing.

text: Choose the word opposite in meaning to: generous.
explanation: A generous person gives freely. A stingy person hates to give.

text: Choose the word opposite in meaning to: expand.
explanation: To expand is to become larger. To contract is to become smaller.

text: Choose the word opposite in meaning to: increase.
explanation: Increase means to become greater. Decrease means to become less.

text: Choose the word opposite in meaning to: accept.
explanation: To accept is to take willingly. To reject is to refuse.

text: Choose the word opposite in meaning to: modern.
explanation: Modern means belonging to the present. Ancient means very long ago.

text: Choose the word opposite in meaning to: optimist.
explanation: An optimist expects good things. A pessimist expects bad things.

text: Choose the word opposite in meaning to: transparent.
explanation: Transparent lets light through. Opaque does not let light through.

text: Choose the word opposite in meaning to: temporary.
explanation: Temporary lasts only for a time. Permanent lasts for good.

text: Choose the word opposite in meaning to: hostile.
explanation: Hostile means unfriendly or opposed. Friendly is its opposite.
